title: VS MEDIA Holdings Limited will Change its Ticker to FCDH from VSME

Forcendra Holding Limited (formerly VS MEDIA Holdings Limited) Announces Shareholder Approval, Effectiveness of Second Amended and Restated Memorandum & Articles of Association and Name Change, and Anticipated Ticker Symbol Change to “FCDH”
VS Media Shareholders Approve Restructuring and Rebrand to Forcendra Holding Limited
